questions.stem: 受暴利吸引，盜獵者（poachers）大量捕捉穿山甲（pangolins），這是牠們瀕臨絕種的主要原因。
questions.answer: Attracted by huge profits, poachers catch large numbers of pangolins, which is the main reason why these animals are endangered.
accepted_answers: Lured by huge profits, poachers hunt pangolins in large numbers, which is the chief reason why pangolins are in danger of dying out.
Driven by enormous profits, poachers have captured a great many pangolins, which is mainly why these animals are on the verge of extinction.

questions.stem: 他們捕捉的穿山甲（pangolins）大多被賣到海外市場，因為許多人相信牠們的鱗片能治病。
questions.answer: Most of the pangolins they catch are sold to overseas markets because many people believe that their scales can cure diseases.
accepted_answers: The pangolins that they catch are mostly sold to markets abroad, as many people believe their scales can cure illnesses.
Most of the pangolins which they capture are sold to foreign markets because many people believe that pangolin scales can treat diseases.

1.explanation_zh: 「受暴利吸引」的主詞就是後面的盜獵者，盜獵者是「被」吸引，用過去分詞構句 Attracted／Lured by huge profits, poachers …（「暴利」是 huge／enormous profits，不要直譯成 violent profits）。「大量捕捉」是 catch large numbers of pangolins，也可以把 in large numbers 放在句尾；穿山甲可數，用 numbers 不用 amount。「這是…的主要原因」的「這」指前面「盜獵者大量捕捉穿山甲」整件事，英文不另起一句，用非限定關係子句 , which is the main reason why …（逗號後面用 which，不能用 that 或 this）。「牠們瀕臨絕種」寫 these animals are endangered，或 are on the verge of extinction／in danger of dying out；are extinct 是「已經絕種」。
evidence: 這是牠們瀕臨絕種的主要原因
1.strategy_zh: 句首「受…」而主詞在後面時想過去分詞構句；句尾「，這是…」的「這」指前面整件事時，想 , which …（非限定關係子句）。
hints: 切成四段：受暴利吸引／盜獵者大量捕捉穿山甲／這是…的主要原因／牠們瀕臨絕種
標的詞彙：attract（吸引）、huge（巨大的）、profit（利潤）、catch（捕捉）、large numbers（大量）、main（主要的）、endangered（瀕臨絕種的）
句型框架：p.p. + by …, S + V + O, which is the main reason why + S + be + adj.

2.explanation_zh: 「他們捕捉的穿山甲」修飾語在前，英文用受格關係子句後位修飾：the pangolins (that) they catch，that 可省略；「大多」可寫 Most of the pangolins …（most of 後面要有 the）。「被賣到海外市場」用被動 are sold to overseas markets。「因為許多人相信…」接完整子句，用 because many people believe (that) …；「牠們的鱗片能治病」是 their scales can cure diseases，sick 是形容詞，不能當 cure 的受詞。
evidence: 他們捕捉的穿山甲（pangolins）大多
2.strategy_zh: 「……的＋名詞」先找修飾語裡有沒有自己的主詞（他們），有就用受格關係子句；看到「被…」用 be + p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：他們捕捉的穿山甲大多／被賣到海外市場／因為許多人相信／牠們的鱗片能治病
標的詞彙：catch（捕捉）、most（大多）、sell（賣）、overseas（海外的）、market（市場）、believe（相信）、scale（鱗片）、cure（治療）、disease（疾病）
句型框架：Most of the + N + (that) + S + V + are sold to …, because + S + believe (that) …

1.restructuring_zh: 「受暴利吸引」省略的主詞就是後面的盜獵者，用過去分詞構句 Attracted by huge profits, …；「這是牠們瀕臨絕種的主要原因」不另起一句，「這」指前面整件事，用 , which is the main reason why … 接在句尾，中文放在句尾的「主要原因」移到 which is 後面。
1.notes_zh: 「這是…的主要原因」的「這」指前面整件事；中文把「主要原因」放在句尾，英文要移到 which is 後面，所以「主要原因」和「這是」一起在第 3 部分評分。第 3 部分寫 , which is the main／major／chief／primary reason (why／that) …、, which is mainly／largely why …、, which mainly／largely explains why …，或 , which is the main cause of …（第 4 部分接名詞片語 their near extinction）都算非限定關係子句。寫成 , and this is the main reason … 或另起一句 This is the main reason … 文法正確，但沒有用到標的句型，不在第 3 部分的可接受寫法內；寫成 , this is the main reason … 是兩個子句只用逗號相連，文法錯誤。只寫 , which is why …／, which explains why … 漏譯「主要」，第 3 部分不給分。第 2 部分「大量捕捉」可寫 catch large numbers of pangolins 或把 in large numbers 放在句尾，時態用現在式、現在完成式（have caught）、現在完成進行式（have been catching）或現在進行式都可以。第 1 部分寫 Being attracted by … 也算分詞構句；寫成 Because they are attracted by … 是副詞子句，沒有用到分詞構句，不在可接受寫法內。第 4 部分「牠們」可寫 these animals、pangolins、they；寫成 are extinct 意思變成「已經絕種」。

traps.literal_error: They catch pangolins are mostly sold to overseas markets, …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語「他們捕捉的」放在名詞前面，照字面直譯會變成兩個動詞；英文要寫成 the pangolins (that) they catch。

2.restructuring_zh: 「他們捕捉的穿山甲大多…」修飾語在前，英文改成 Most of the pangolins (that) they catch …，「大多」移到句首寫成 Most of；「被賣到」用被動 are sold to。
2.notes_zh: 第 1 部分也可以寫 The pangolins (that) they catch are mostly …（這時第 2 部分從 sold to … 開始）或 The majority of the pangolins they catch …；「他們」指上一句的盜獵者，也可以直接寫 poachers。只寫 The pangolins they catch are sold … 漏譯「大多」，第 1 部分不給分。寫成分詞片語 the pangolins caught by them 沒有用到標的關係子句，不在可接受寫法內。「海外市場」寫 overseas markets、foreign markets、markets abroad，或簡寫成 are sold overseas 都可以。「因為許多人相信」也可以寫 because it is widely believed that …。

1.translation: Attracted by huge profits, poachers capture pangolins in large numbers, which is the main reason why these animals are on the verge of extinction.
1.explanation_zh: 「受暴利吸引」是主詞（poachers）被動作吸引，用過去分詞片語 Attracted by huge profits 放句首作原因副詞。「大量捕捉」譯成 capture pangolins in large numbers。「這是……的主要原因」指前面整件事，所以用 which 引導的非限定關係子句，which is the main reason why ...。「瀕臨絕種」譯成 be on the verge of extinction（也可說 be endangered）。現在簡單式表示一般性的盜獵情況。

2.translation: Most of the pangolins they catch are sold to overseas markets because many people believe that the animals' scales can cure diseases.
2.explanation_zh: 「他們捕捉的穿山甲」用省略關係代名詞的關係子句 the pangolins (that) they catch，修飾 pangolins。「大多」譯成 Most of the pangolins ... are sold，主詞是複數所以 be 動詞用 are，並用被動語態。「賣到海外市場」是 sold to overseas markets。「因為許多人相信……」用 because many people believe that ...，「牠們的鱗片」的「牠們」指穿山甲，為避免 their 指向不明，寫成 the animals' scales；「能治病」是 can cure diseases。
